FORM No. 3
G. 35,000.35

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S. 2, Special Branch, D
REPORT
File No.... S. B. REC[EIPT]... 67113
Date...... May 25, 1935.

Subject................ F. Chestakovsky, Soviet Diplomatic Courier.

Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky. Forwarded by [Signature].

Fedor Chestakovsky, 45, Soviet Diplomatic Courier,
arrived in Shanghai from Moscow via Japan, on May 20, 1935 in
the s.s. "President Johnson," accompanied by another courier,
Nicolas Genjuzist.
Chestakovsky holds a Diplomatic Passport No.3131
issued by the People's Commissariat of Foreign Affairs on
January 23, 1935. This passport bears a Chinese visa issued
by the Chinese Embassy in Moscow on April 24, 1935.
On the "Alien Declaration Form" Chestakovsky stated
that after a short stay in Shanghai he would proceed to Nanking
and Peiping.

D. S. Tcheremshansky
D. S.

D. C. (Special Branch).
[Signature]
25 MAY 1935
